tool_input.body:
## Summary

Two things, the second discovered while trying to land the first:

1. **Beads sync** — records `xboing-fvzw` (the cppcheck-pin work shipped in #239) in the git-tracked tracker; its Dolt export was left uncommitted. Other `issues.jsonl` churn is bd regenerating internal record UUIDs; no bead status/timestamp changed.
2. **CI macOS runner fix** — the `macos-14` runner label stopped allocating (GitHub retired/rotated the image): jobs cancelled in ~1s with no runner, which blocked this PR's required macOS checks. `test.yml` now uses `macos-latest`, which allocates and passes (verified: `build (macos-latest, debug, build)` and `install-brew (macos-latest)` both green with real runners). The master ruleset's required-check contexts were updated to match.

Includes the ethos audit-seal files the pre-commit hook attaches.

## Follow-up (filed separately)

`release.yml` also pins `macos-14` for Homebrew **bottle** builds (`arm64_sonoma`). Moving it to `macos-latest` changes the bottle OS tag (→ Sequoia) and affects the tap, so it needs deliberate handling — tracked in its own bead, not bundled here.

## Test plan

- [x] macOS jobs allocate runners and pass on `macos-latest`
- [x] All required checks green; PR mergeable is CLEAN
- [x] Beads diff verified: only `xboing-fvzw` added, no other bead state changed

tool_input.new_string:
- **macOS**: the bottle tag encodes the OS *codename*
  (`arm64_<codename>` — e.g. `arm64_sequoia` for macOS 15 — derived
  from whatever version the `macos-latest` runner currently images,
  not the numeric "15"). The tag floats with `macos-latest`: a user
  on a different macOS major version sees `brew` refuse the bottle
  and fall back to a source build, because bottles do not cross
  macOS major versions. When GitHub advances `macos-latest` to a new
  OS, the next release's bottle carries the new codename; older-tag
  bottles will not install from the tap without re-cutting a release.
  There is no macOS Intel bottle in this scope — the tap is Apple
  Silicon only, matching the `macos-latest` (arm64) runner.

build(ci): migrate release.yml + docs off retired macos-14 runner

GitHub stopped allocating the `macos-14` runner label (jobs cancel in
~1s with no runner; confirmed 2026-11-06, and `macos-latest` allocates
and passes). PR #240 already moved test.yml's CI matrix; this finishes
the class across the rest of the repo so a release tag won't fail.

- release.yml: smoke-brew and bottle matrices use `macos-latest`. The
  bottle job already reads its tag dynamically from `*.bottle.json` and
  validates with an `arm64_<codename>` regex, so the tag floating from
  `arm64_sonoma` to `arm64_sequoia` needs no code change — only the
  explanatory comments.
- test.yml: stale `macos-14` mentions in comments/step names.
- docs/CI.md: required-check names (`build (macos-latest, debug, build)`,
  `install-brew (macos-latest)`) now match the updated master ruleset.
- docs/RELEASING.md: bottle-tag section reflects the floating codename.
- packaging/homebrew/xboing.rb: comment reference.

Beads: closes xboing-xvxi.
